visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a light purple long-sleeved blouse and a beige fabric apron is seen in a clean, modern white-themed kitchen. She uses both hands to carefully position a large, light-colored ceramic pot and a matching mixing bowl on a sleek white Panasonic induction cooktop. The background features white tiled walls and minimalist decor with bright overhead lighting. (2) The woman opens a tall, white, multi-door refrigerator neatly organized with clear containers. She reaches in and retrieves a metallic tray containing several vacuum-sealed packages of marinated meat, including chicken and pork. The lighting inside the fridge is cool and bright. (3) In a close-up, the woman opens a light-colored wooden drawer to pull out a roll of white parchment paper. She tears a sheet and lines a rectangular metal tray. Her hands are adorned with a simple silver bracelet. The counter is white and clutter-free. (4) The woman uses wooden chopsticks to transfer pieces of marinated chicken wings and a large seasoned steak from plastic packaging onto the parchment-lined tray. She arranges them neatly for even cooking, showcasing the glossy texture of the marinated meat. (5) She carries the prepared tray to a white digital air fryer, slides it inside, and presses buttons on the circular digital interface. The background shows a white curtain with the words "a little" printed on it. (6) The woman pours cooking oil from a glass bottle into a stainless steel pan. She then moves to a grey cutting board where she uses a sharp chef's knife to slice a fresh green zucchini into thin, triangular pieces with calm, methodical movements. (7) A close-up shows the woman cracking two eggs into a small stainless steel bowl and pouring them into the hot pan with zucchini slices. She stir-frys the ingredients with a wooden spatula while steam rises. Nearby, a white pot simmers with rib and carrot soup. (8) The woman adds minced garlic from a glass jar and a large amount of green leafy vegetables into the sizzling pan. She continues to toss the vegetables with the spatula, ensuring they are evenly cooked and vibrant in color. (9) She retrieves the cooked golden-brown chicken wings and steak from the air fryer. She uses kitchen scissors to cut the steak into bite-sized strips over a white ceramic plate, which is then placed on a wooden dining table. (10) Finally, she pours braised meat from a pot into a white bowl and skims off excess oil. The complete meal is shown arranged on the table. A raw salmon steak is shown briefly at the end, remaining in its tray.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a sharp, high-frequency metallic 'clink' as a pot is placed on an induction surface. A gentle, mid-tempo piano melody enters with a warm, lyrical quality. There is a clean studio-like noise floor. (2) A distinct mechanical 'thud' and the sound of a vacuum seal breaking as the refrigerator door is opened. The piano music maintains a steady, comforting rhythm with a slight room resonance of an indoor kitchen. (3) Low-frequency friction noise of a wooden drawer sliding open, followed by the crisp, high-frequency crinkling of parchment paper being unrolled. The musical theme continues with soft chordal piano accompaniment. (4) Repetitive metallic percussive sounds of chopsticks tapping against a metal tray as meat is handled. The piano melody shifts to a slightly more upbeat progression. There are no vocal interruptions. (5) An electronic 'beep' signals air fryer activation. The mechanical sound of the air fryer door clicking shut is heard, followed by a faint, continuous broadband whirring sound of the internal fan. (6) A liquid pouring sound is immediately followed by a rhythmic series of percussive 'thuds' on a cutting board, indicating rapid knife work. The piano music provides a consistent rhythmic bed. (7) A sharp crack of an eggshell followed by a soft liquid splash. Shortly after, a sustained, high-frequency white-noise sizzle begins as ingredients hit the hot pan, overlapping with the scraping sound of wood on metal. (8) Low-frequency gurgling of a simmering stew is audible. The scraping sounds of the spatula become more frequent as vegetables are added. The piano music remains prominent in the mix. (9) The air fryer whirring stops with a final mechanical click. This is followed by the sharp, metallic 'snip' and 'crunch' sounds of kitchen scissors cutting through crispy cooked meat. (10) Ceramic clatter as plates are moved onto a wooden table. A liquid ladling sound is heard as soup is poured. The piano piece concludes with a gentle, decaying chord sequence, fading into silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the quiet, therapeutic process of a woman preparing a home-cooked meal alone. It serves to emphasize the importance of 'input' or recharging time for introverted individuals (I-type personalities), particularly mothers, through the sensory-rich experience of cooking and domestic tasks.
